system.description:
Requirements: You must have access to be trained by another Arbiter or have access to their teachings

In years past, Arbiters would travel the world to destroy demonic spirits and malfeasant sacred artists. Today, many of the techniques they employed have been collected by law enforcement agencies, secret police, and exorcists, who use them to root out mortal and spiritual corruption alike.

  • Select 1 Path Ability with the Arbiter trait. You immediately gain that Ability without the associated XP cost.

  • You have Advantage on checks to determine whether a creature or object is affected by supernatural corruption, as well as any checks made to track or research supernatural creatures.
